tasks.name: EmailMonitorTick
tasks.purpose: Every 5 minutes: one heartbeat tick that watches every configured mailbox, classifies new mail, alerts the important ones and applies the configured labels.

health.label: email-monitor spine (5 min) -- rc!=0 or state/ stale => not processing mail

tasks.name: EmailClassificationReview
tasks.purpose: Daily 21:30: run the companion's classification review over the tick log and notify only when the verdict needs action; the exit code is the verdict. Opt-in: it needs the companion's scripts/classification-review.ps1.

health.label: email topic-kernel verdict review (daily 21:30)
health.reason: The exit code is a verdict, not a failure: 2 = the model chain had failures, 3 = the gate refused more than it accepted (a taxonomy gap), 4 = mail arrived and nothing judged it. The wrapper notifies in those cases itself. The report is written on every run, which still catches an rc 0 run that produced nothing.
